thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired: service=autoscaler.queue.backlog — backlog=2298 reqs, p99 latency=2.3s, errors=12/min. INC12345
pagerduty: INC12345 triggered — routing to eng-oncall. https://pagerduty/INC12345

Tina: acked on PD — i'm oncall, taking lead. checking dashboards now :mag:

Alex: looking at cluster events — autoscaler desired=80, current=42, failed node provisioning for last 15m with quota errors. Controller logs show repeated quota rejections.

Mohit: confirmed. Cloud API returning `QuotaExceeded: InsufficientVMQuota` for us-west2, bump requests returning 4-5m ETA. This is why autoscaler can't fulfill desired nodes.

Tina: customer impact: Support reports 14 p1s for inference timeouts, some traffic hitting inference API getting 502/timeout. We'll need immediate mitigation path.

Alex: possible immediate actions:
- manual scale of dedicated pool with available reserved nodes in us-east
- route non-critical training/batch traffic to a deferred pool
- throttle burst routing for new sessions

Mohit: i can spin up nodes in us-east from our reserved quota now. takes ~90s for container warmup, then kv-cache warmup another ~2m.

Tina: do manual scale then. i'll coordinate with Support to move impacted customer traffic to degraded mode.

Alex: running manual scale command now:
```
# bump inference-worker in dedicated pool
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-worker-dedicated --replicas=70
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-worker-dedicated
```

ops-bot: API call to cloud provider accepted — new nodes requested: 28. Provisioning in progress.

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by Tina — escalation to Mohit (sre-manager) in 5m if not resolved.

Mohit: while nodes come up, i'm enabling temporary routing rule to send new low-priority requests to fallback pool (degraded mode). applying patch.

Alex: applied routing patch to route `x-traffic-class=background` to fallback pool. Also disabling prefetch-heavy jobs for 20m.

Tina: Support update -> we've set expectations with affected customers; some see 20-40s delays, others hit timeouts earlier. asking for any urgent customers to be escalated to manual replays.

ops-bot: new nodes reporting `Ready` and joining pool. KV cache warmup in progress (approx 60% after 45s).

Alex: observed queue length dropping from 2298 -> 860 in 4m after manual scale + routing changes. p95 latency improving.

Mohit: autoscaler controller logs show it had queued scale operations but blocked on cloud quota errors; I've redeployed a small controller patch to make it fallback faster on quota errors (will watch for regressions).

Tina: good. i'm preparing a short incident summary for post-handoff. next oncall @ 02:00 UTC, i'll hand off current state and the runbook link.

SRE-manager: noted. if rollout of controller patch looks stable in 10m, we'll close PD. keep the postmortem stub updated.

Tina: handing off to @alex for overlap. Alex — can you keep an eye for any customer regressions and confirm autoscaler resumes safe behavior?

Alex: on it — will monitor dashboards and check controller logs. will escalate if queue climbs again >1000.

Tina: :thumbsup: releasing PD ack for now, will leave incident marked 'mitigated' until autoscaler fully recovered.

pagerduty: INC12345 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated (timestamp: 1769877123)

Tina: notes for handoff:
- root cause: cloud VM quota exhaustion prevented autoscaler from provisioning nodes
- mitigations: manual scale (us-east), routing reroute for low-priority, redeployed autoscaler fallback patch
- impact: 14 support escalations, transient 502/timeouts for a subset of customers
- follow-up: request quota increase with cloud, expand reserved pool, postmortem scheduled.

Alex: adding command snippets used to triage to runbook:
```
kubectl logs -n prod deployment/scale-controller --tail=200 | grep QuotaExceeded
kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker-dedicated --replicas=70 -n prod
kubectl apply -f routing-defer-patch.yaml
```

Tina: thanks all — handing off fully. next oncall, see thread for details. :white_check_mark:
